titleTh: ฝนรายชั่วโมง ช่วงฝนตกหนักกรุงเทพฯ 25–27 ก.ย. 2569 (ข้อมูลประมาณการ ERA5)
titleEn: Hourly rainfall, Bangkok heavy-rain event 25–27 Sep 2026 (ERA5 reanalysis estimate)

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (Copernicus Climate Change Service, C3S), hourly precipitation (models=era5)
provenance.geographicScope: Single ERA5 0.25° cell answering 13.72639°N 100.56°E (TMD synoptic station 48455 “Bangkok Metropolis” coordinates as published in ThaiWater station metadata (TMD normals report: 13°43'N 100°33'E). Used as a citable city-centre reference point.); model cell 13.75°N 100.5°E.
provenance.methodology: Modelled reanalysis hourly precipitation (mm), not gauge data. ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (Copernicus Climate Change Service, C3S), 0.25° × 0.25° regular latitude/longitude grid (≈27–28 km), hourly. Open-Meteo convention: the value stamped at hour T is the accumulation over the preceding hour (T−1h, T], local time Asia/Bangkok (UTC+7). Rounded to 0.1 mm. Event total 197.1 mm; peak hour 7.7 mm ending 2026-09-25T12:00:00+07:00; max rolling 24 h 92.3 mm ending 2026-09-26T18:00:00+07:00. Requested point 13.72639°N 100.56°E (TMD synoptic station 48455 “Bangkok Metropolis” coordinates as published in ThaiWater station metadata (TMD normals report: 13°43'N 100°33'E). Used as a citable city-centre reference point.); answering ERA5 cell 13.75°N 100.5°E. Retrieved 2026-11-03T23:01:43.974Z.
limitations: Single ≈27–28 km reanalysis cell; local gauge peaks can be much higher than the cell value.
Model output; timing of convective peaks can be shifted by hours.

This window coincides with the documented 25–27 Sep 2026 Bangkok flood; BMA gauges recorded up to 210.0 mm in 24 h (07:00 25 Sep → 07:00 26 Sep) versus 88 mm for this ERA5 cell's wettest local day — use for timing/shape, not depth.
